Type: table
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Industrial Mango-Topped Side Table, 19.61"W
Colors: Walnut/Charcoal
Materials: Metal
The parquetry design of this mango-topped piece turns a side table into a point of visual interest wherever it is placed. Metal legs in an X shape provide stability and add a modern element. No assembly and compact dimensions make this table a convenient and stylish feature to add to any room. 19.61"W x 19.61"D x 21.65"H Made with mango top and metal base This stylish console table features a parquetry top that adds classic appeal to your space. Ships fully assembled. All seams are welded, and there are no exposed screws or bolts. Table features a solid wood parquetry top. No assembly required Clean with a soft, damp cloth. Avoid placing furniture near heat vents or open windows. Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
